claim: Microsoft describes its zero-water cooling design as saving about 125 million liters per facility each year and targeting zero-water evaporation as a standard for new builds by late 2027.
displayValue: ~125M liters saved per facility each year
comparisonContext: This gives the page a concrete example of companies trying to break the old 'less water always means more energy' tradeoff.
scopeNote: This is a company-reported design claim; independent performance verification is still limited.
sourceTitle: Sustainable by Design: Zero Water Cooling
